narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives were the same. Then the phone gave out, and you chose {real_choice} while the ghost took {ghost_choice}. {first_bar_apart} parted first, that same month: the share of each pay packet claimed before it arrives. The ghost's money sat above yours for {ghost_ahead_months} month, and from month {crossover_month} it sat below and stayed there. By month {end_month} the ghost had finished {net_worth_gap}. Its room to go without pay ended {safety_gap}.
